authority_precedence: exact field authority for the definition being used
identity_rules: A source hash is part of the experimental subject.
Byte-different artifacts remain different source versions until an explicit transformation or adjudication record says otherwise.
A rendered PDF is not a separate semantic authority when it is a verified rendering of a registered textual source.
A source may be canonical for terminology and still license no empirical or product claim.
Mutable runtime and product-status records are time-indexed and must be re-read; they are not frozen by this matrix.

unresolved_conflicts.summary: Native A1-D10 and normalized A0-D9 indexing require a tested bijection carrying both source symbol and normalized index.
D3DAC0EF and A124302E definition payloads contain substantive string differences and remain separate semantic versions.
A rich 28-definition source used by fixtures is absent from the normalized canon manifest.
Two 22-item Acquisition constructions lack an approved crosswalk.
Noncanonical programming-book operator names remain comparator-only until reconciled.
Native TKS World, CAS Domain, and CAS Register are separate axes; mapping hypotheses may not be declared identities.
TKS Foundations and CAS Core Drives share positions in some artifacts but not definition identity.
The executable mod-10 algebra does not establish equivalence to all TKS composition structures.
Fixtures, captures, and reports are not uniformly bound to exact semantic and crosswalk hashes.
The formal Noetic Topos does not license product-facing detection claims.
Paper definitions and proof sketches, implementation tests, formal verification, and empirical evidence require distinct statuses.
No separate exact main.md source was located; it must not be represented as reviewed.
The supplied 2026-07-26 PCBA build postdates its latest named changelog version.
The raw hashes identify CRLF and LF serializations of the same compiler text; the normalized current bytes equal the registry-bound Git blob.
